Introduction

Apeace Jade5, formerly known as Apeace Jade, was one of three sub-units of the boy group Apeace. The unit began promotions in September 2012 with seven members: Dongho, Jaewon, Youngwon, Wonsik, Seunghwan, Sehyun, and Youngwook. With the departure of member Seunghwan in 2013, new member Doohee was added to the group.

After Apeace went through several lineup changes, eventually reaching a total of 15 members, the units were reorganized into groups of five. With Jade becoming Jade5, the new lineup consisted of Youngwon, Wonsik, Geonhee, Duhwan, and J.D. The group later stopped promoting in sub-units around 2015, following the departures and hiatuses of several members.
